author: guardia lab
name: osquery: new persistence entry on a Windows host
description: A scheduled osquery check (pack lab-persistence-and-tooling) reported a new autostart entry: Run/RunOnceEx key or Startup folder item, Winlogon helper, IFEO debugger, service, scheduled task, WMI event consumer or DNS server plugin DLL. Differential results: only entries that appeared since the previous run; the baseline run (counter 0) is excluded.
query: pack_name:"lab-persistence-and-tooling" and osquery_meta.action:"added" and not osquery_meta.counter:0 and query_name:(startup_items or runonceex_registry or winlogon_helpers or ifeo_debugger or services or scheduled_tasks or wmi_cli_consumers or wmi_script_consumers or dns_server_plugin_dll)
false_positives: Software installation or updates creating services, tasks or Run keys

author: guardia lab
name: osquery: YARA match in a user-writable folder
description: The scheduled osquery YARA scan (YARA Forge Core rules) matched a file under C:\Users, C:\Windows\Temp or C:\PerfLogs. Includes matches found on the first scan.
false_positives: Security or administration tools with signatures of offensive tools

author: guardia lab
name: osquery: security tool or logging setting changed
description: A scheduled osquery check reported a change to a security service (Sysmon, Elastic Agent, Elastic Defend, Microsoft Defender, Event Log), to command-line or PowerShell logging settings, or AMSI disabled for a user. Baseline run excluded, except for AMSI disabled.
query: pack_name:"lab-persistence-and-tooling" and ((query_name:(security_tooling_services or telemetry_settings) and not osquery_meta.counter:0) or (query_name:"amsi_disabled" and osquery_meta.action:"added"))
note: ATT&CK v19 moved defence impairment techniques (see T1685 in the emulation report); this mapping uses the pre-v19 ID and needs reconciliation.
false_positives: Planned maintenance or upgrade of the security tools
